title: Codex transcript lookup: resolve sessions from CODEX_HOME, treating unset or empty as ~/.codex
answers: Codex traces are missing model, tool calls, or token usage when the launcher uses a custom Codex home directory
Where does the Codex integration find rollout transcript files for a thread?
Why does Codex enrichment fall back to the notify payload only when CODEX_HOME is set?
Why does an empty CODEX_HOME environment variable still look in ~/.codex?
body:
Path: Codex tracing enrichment. When a Codex thread finishes, the integration looks up its rollout JSONL transcript by thread ID to add model, tool calls/results, span timing, and token usage. The lookup is `findTranscriptForThread` in libs/typescript/integrations/codex/src/transcript.ts, which scans `<codex home>/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/`.
Rule: The codex home is `process.env.CODEX_HOME || join(homedir(), '.codex')` in `findTranscriptForThread`. Use `||`, not `??`, so an empty string falls back to the legacy home like an unset variable does; Codex itself treats empty as unset, and launchers often forward optional variables as ''. Any new code that locates Codex state should use the same resolution.
Symptom: Traces from Codex runs launched with a custom CODEX_HOME (for example Omnigent) showed only the notify-payload data, with no model, tool calls, timing, or token usage. With an empty CODEX_HOME, enrichment searched `./sessions` or missed the transcript that Codex wrote to ~/.codex/sessions.
Constraints: Applies to locating transcript files only. The sessions search is still skipped if the directory does not exist, and the lookup stays optional so tracing works without it. Regression tests in libs/typescript/integrations/codex/tests/transcript.test.ts (`findTranscriptForThread`) cover CODEX_HOME precedence over homedir, the unset case, and the empty case; they mock `node:os` homedir and restore process.env.CODEX_HOME after each test.
applies: Codex integration transcript discovery in libs/typescript/integrations/codex; does not cover other Codex config or state files.
says: Codex traces lack model and token usage when the launcher uses a custom Codex home folder.
Codex enrichment misses tool calls when CODEX_HOME is set to a custom directory.
An empty CODEX_HOME still reads from the wrong sessions folder; how is it resolved?
search: Codex transcript lookup resolves the Codex home as CODEX_HOME with the logical or operator, so unset or empty falls back to the home-directory .codex folder. The rollout transcript search under sessions dated folders is skipped if the directory is missing, and the lookup stays optional. Applies to locating transcript files only.
